name: Declared-schema conformance (4 tables)
formula: rows without Table Schema error / rows
note: frictionless 5.19.1; tables: dams, capacity-history, storage, transfers

name: Resource paths that resolve
formula: resources whose path exists / resources
note: all resolve

name: Strengthened storage contract
formula: storage rows passing 8 stricter rules / rows
note: rules in schema/storage_contract_v2.json; per-rule counts in K03_storage_contract_checks.csv; frictionless check of the v2 field constraints: valid=True, errors=0

name: Key uniqueness (dam_id, date)
formula: 1 - duplicate keys / rows

name: Source traceability of storage rows
formula: rows whose SHA-256 and file equal the manifest Page 1 entry and that carry a lineage id / rows

name: Value completeness of printed dam rows
formula: numeric storage rows / Page 1 dam rows printed
note: 1 printed row(s) carry a source blank; Page 1 rows in the staged view: 129391

name: Source roster coverage (publisher side)
formula: dam rows printed / (governed dams x Page 1 bulletin dates)
note: measures what DGBGTH printed (roster growth, dams not yet reported), not an extraction defect

name: Coverage inside each dam's reporting era
formula: storage rows / Page 1 bulletin dates between the dam's first and last printed row
note: Q17 mixed the P1-or-P2 union (129,508) with a calendar-day denominator

name: Date columns that match the DLO phenomenon time
formula: rows whose published date equals the DLO 0.3 phenomenon time / rows with an asserted rule
note: storage 129390/129390; transfers 0/31704 (published date = bulletin date with rule SAME_DAY; DLO: day D-1 for daily, interval for season totals)

name: Page 1 = Page 2 storage (same dam, same day)
formula: pairs equal at 0.001 Mm3 / pairs where both pages print a number
note: 0 more pairs within one printed unit; different: 1

name: Page 1 = Page 2 inflow (same dam, same day)
formula: pairs equal at 0.001 Mm3 / pairs where both pages print a number
note: 1 more pairs within one printed unit; different: 7

name: Page 1 = Page 2 outflow (same dam, same day)
formula: pairs equal at 0.001 Mm3 / pairs where both pages print a number
note: 2 more pairs within one printed unit; different: 56

name: Daily vs inflow month-to-date counter
formula: |C_t - C_(t-1) - D_t| <= 0.0015 Mm3 on consecutive days, reset where the day D-1 starts a new period
note: QA reset the counter on the bulletin date; DLO 0.3 (rules MTD/STD) resets it on the day D-1

name: Daily vs outflow month-to-date counter
formula: |C_t - C_(t-1) - D_t| <= 0.0015 Mm3 on consecutive days, reset where the day D-1 starts a new period
note: QA reset the counter on the bulletin date; DLO 0.3 (rules MTD/STD) resets it on the day D-1

name: Daily vs inflow season-to-date counter
formula: |C_t - C_(t-1) - D_t| <= 0.0015 Mm3 on consecutive days, reset where the day D-1 starts a new period
note: QA reset the counter on the bulletin date; DLO 0.3 (rules MTD/STD) resets it on the day D-1; without the Ziatine/Gamgoum rows (column swap, see K10_ziatine_gamgoum_swap_test.csv): 118928/119948 = 99.15 %

name: Daily vs outflow season-to-date counter
formula: |C_t - C_(t-1) - D_t| <= 0.0015 Mm3 on consecutive days, reset where the day D-1 starts a new period
note: QA reset the counter on the bulletin date; DLO 0.3 (rules MTD/STD) resets it on the day D-1

name: Printed fill = storage / useful capacity
formula: printed fill interval intersects [100(V-dV)/(C+dC), 100(V+dV)/(C-dC)] / comparable rows
note: QA rounding rule (fill only) passes 80814; it ignored the rounding of V (0.0005) and C (0.005)

name: National total = sum of dam storage
formula: |sum V_i - T_printed| <= n x 0.0005 + half printed unit / complete bulletins
note: 4 roster-scope dates excluded as in F

name: Physically possible storage value
formula: finite and non-negative storage / rows
note: storage above useful capacity is possible (flood surcharge, capacity after sedimentation) and is kept as diagnostic D1

name: Storage above useful capacity
formula: rows with V > C / rows with a known capacity
note: 836 of 836 such rows with a printed fill show fill >= 100 % in the bulletin itself; median excess 0.42 %

name: Page 3 daily vs season total (qualified)
formula: |C_t - C_(t-1) - D_t| <= 0.0015 Mm3, season reset on the day D-1
note: without a reset rule this reproduces Q14 exactly (13129/14229); 44 season-reset rows (bulletin of 2 September) are no longer counted as mismatches

name: Page 1 extraction accuracy (sample)
formula: matching source cells / verifiable sampled cells (95 % Wilson lower bound in note)
note: Wilson lower bound 0.9952; needs the PDFs to recompute

name: Page 2 extraction accuracy (sample)
formula: matching source cells / verifiable sampled cells (95 % Wilson lower bound in note)
note: Wilson lower bound 0.9952; needs the PDFs to recompute

name: Page 3 transcription accuracy (sample)
formula: matching source cells / verifiable sampled cells (95 % Wilson lower bound in note)
note: Wilson lower bound 0.9952; needs the PDFs to recompute

name: Fields with a description
formula: schema fields with a non-empty description / schema fields

name: Licences cleared for publication
formula: licences not marked PENDING / licences
note: publication gate: CC-BY-4.0, TN-LNDPO

name: Water balance closes within printed rounding
formula: |V_t - V_(t-1) - Q_in + Q_out| <= 0.002 Mm3 / consecutive days
note: evaporation, seepage, spill and timing are not printed, so non-closure is expected and is not an error rate

name: Robust storage-change review flags
formula: |0.6745 (dV - median) / MAD| >= 6 / comparable daily changes
note: carried from the automated QA; 7644 changes had MAD = 0 and got no score
